existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: Library keeps its identity and has no local required-element, removed-element, or reference-target break. The top concerns are R6-only metadata (`versionAlgorithm[x]`, `copyrightLabel`), changed terminology/semantics for `subject[x]` and `jurisdiction`, and new warning constraints on canonical URLs and dependency/component related artifacts. Confidence is medium because several terminology changes require external expansions or official migration notes.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is mostly about metadata interpretation and round-trip policy. R4-to-R6 import can preserve most existing Library content, but validators may emit new warnings and downstream business logic should revisit jurisdiction, topic, experimental, and dependency semantics. R6-to-R4 export needs extensions or loss-acceptance for R6-only optional fields and may need ConceptMaps or local rules for terminology binding changes.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural facts directly present in the two StructureDefinitions: no local element removals, no existing cardinality changes, new optional elements, and direct type/binding/constraint deltas. Confidence is lower for terminology impact because expansions were not performed and the R6 package points some bindings to external terminology.hl7.org value sets absent from the local package.
